author: founder
sentences: Last year, I almost quit making videos, editing 8 every evening at almost nobody watched.
I had spent 3000 hours editing by hand.
This is literally brutal way to make anything.
The slow part was always a rough cut.
Then I checked my workflow and the rough cut went from 90 minutes to 10 minutes.
That change gave me my evenings back and honestly it was not luck.
There are three reasons it worked.
Third everything runs on my laptop.
I record a clip, drop it in and read the result.
If a caption is wrong, I fix the word and move on.
Now I publish every week instead of every month.
Last month those clips earned $12 ,000 in sales.
So I keep talking to my camera and let the software handle the rest.
Your ideas matter more than your timeline.
